env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

! exists logos.toml

# Burn1(n) costs 7 + 3n steps, so Burn1(33331) spends exactly the 100,000
# default and Burn1(33332) spends 100,003.
logos run ./at
stdout '^at: 33332$'

! logos build -o $WORK/over$GOEXE ./over
stderr '\[comptime::ctfe_step_limit\]'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/steps

go 1.27

-- burn/burn.lgo --
package burn

const func Burn1(n int) int {
	total := 0
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		total++
	}
	total++
	return total
}

-- at/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/steps/burn"
)

const At = burn.Burn1(33331)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("at:", At)
}

-- over/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/steps/burn"
)

const Over = burn.Burn1(33332)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("over:", Over)
}
